verses.text: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
The life is more than the food, and the body than the raiment.
Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
And which of you with being anxious can add to his stature one cubit?
If ye then be not able to do even a very little thing, why are ye anxious about the rest?

section: Seek Ye the Kingdom of God
